exclusion_criterion: Tasks representing autonomous LLM background analysis without developer-in-the-loop interaction (e.g., Bug prediction, Patch correctness prediction, Code representation, Invariant prediction) were excluded. In contrast, developer-in-the-loop quality and maintenance tasks (e.g., Vulnerability detection, Defect detection, Bug localization, Code clone detection) were retained because developers actively review, triage, and act upon the assistant's output during the task execution.

tasks.description: Analyzing textual requirements from software stakeholders during software construction or maintenance, evaluating completeness, and resolving specification conflicts.
Categorizing raw requirement statements into functional, non-functional, security, and domain-specific requirement categories.
Synthesizing structured use cases, actor interactions, and flow of events from high-level software requirement descriptions.
Formulating high-level software component structures, architectural patterns, and inter-module interaction models.
Generating technical software design specifications and module contracts from requirement specifications.
Synthesizing executable code blocks, functions, or feature implementations directly from natural language task prompts or specifications.
Completing partially typed code lines, function bodies, or statement blocks during active typing in an editor.
Modifying, restructuring, and optimizing existing source code blocks or module implementations for readability, performance, or architectural alignment.
Generating high-level natural language summaries, module descriptions, and documentation from code.
Retrieving relevant code snippets or repository implementations matching natural language query prompts.
Translating source code logic from one programming language or paradigm to another while preserving functional intent.
Recommending relevant library APIs, method signatures, and usage patterns for a given developer task context.
Generating inline docstrings, API comments, and header notes for source code functions and classes.
Synthesizing automated unit test suites, test inputs, assertions, and test oracles for software validation.
Scanning source code for security flaws, unsafe memory operations, and vulnerable API usage patterns.
Identifying potential software bugs, logic flaws, and runtime anti-patterns in source code.
Pinpointing specific source files, methods, or lines responsible for reported software bug symptoms.
Diagnosing buggy code and generating patch fixes to pass failing test cases or bug reports.
Inspecting code changes submitted in pull requests, identifying quality issues, and generating review comments.
Renaming identifiers, function names, or class names across a repository for consistency and readability.
Tracing program execution steps, stack traces, and variable states to isolate root causes of runtime errors.
Generating reproducible test scripts or steps to reproduce reported bug reports in a target environment.
Identifying duplicated or near-identical code blocks across a software repository for consolidation.
Generating and updating build scripts, environment files, dependency manifests, and continuous integration pipeline configs.
Estimating development effort, task complexity, and implementation story points for software work items.
